items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Hank something...I can't think of his name. ... Oh yeah, he was good. Very good.

ctx.x: Was it five horns or four horns?
Five horns and three rhythm. And Stanley Overton on piano, P.G. on drums. Let me see, who was the bass player? Hank something...I can't think of his name.
